key_idea: Count the cubes in each block.
steps: A: 3 on the bottom and 3 on top. 3 + 3 = 6.
B: 3 on the bottom and 2 stacked on the left. 3 + 2 = 5. E: 2 + 2 + 1 = 5.
C: 3 on the bottom and 1 on top. 3 + 1 = 4. D: 3 + 2 + 2 = 7.

choice_feedback.B: B has 5 cubes, 1 more than C.
choice_feedback.E: E has 5 cubes, 1 more than C.
